biggest_catch: It's bill credit, not cash — $75 for an internet-only referral or $100 for internet-plus-mobile, and your friend must keep Astound service active and in good standing for 60 days before either of you sees a cent (credit posts ~60 days after their install).
catches: Bill credits only — no cash value, not redeemable for cash, not transferable
Referred friend must be new to Astound (no Astound service within 60 days), activate within 30 days of the referral, and keep service active in good standing for 60 days
Credit posts approximately 60 days after the referred customer's install; forfeited if either account is cancelled before it applies
Max $1,200 in referral credits per person/account per calendar year
Bulk-agreement (apartment bulk billing) accounts and Astound employees/sales agents excluded
May not be combined with other referral rewards or similar programs
